notes_for_editor: Stub-level record. Standing status and coordinates come from the FFLA list. The name match to Mapcarta's Slaty Lick Knob Lookout Tower is inferred from the coordinates, not confirmed by any agency. The local GNIS peaks file lists Slate Lick Knob at 39.4223, -78.7903; it is not cited because the GNIS page fetched without usable text. Slate Lick does not appear on the Forest Lookouts or NHLR West Virginia lists as crawled. Build date, design, builder, staffing, access and fires are unknown. Mapcarta's 'Slaty' spelling should be checked against a county or Forest Service source before the name is changed.
